ITEM 1 | Broccoli florets, dark green with slightly lighter tops, firm bumpy florets clustered on the right side of the plate, about 6 cm across in a cluster, some florets split with stems attached, roughly 2 cm tall, sitting on the plate surface with no sauce | 75
ITEM 2 | Shredded carrot, bright orange thin matchstick strands, moist and slightly glossy, loosely piled on the left over the greens, strands about 4-5 cm long | 15
ITEM 3 | Mixed leafy greens, dark green wilted and glossy leaves with some lighter pale green pieces, flat and layered, spanning about 7 cm by 6 cm on the left-center, about 1 cm high, moist surface | 45
ITEM 4 | Cucumber slices, pale green with lighter flesh and darker skin edges, thin rounds and half-moons, about 3 cm across, slightly translucent, lying on top of the leaves at the top-left | 12
ITEM 5 | Cherry tomato half, bright red-orange skin with paler inner flesh, cut face up, about 2 cm across, smooth and glossy, sitting below the carrot shreds at the bottom-left of the greens | 8
